name: Harry Bennett
role: Cowhand who drove horses and cattle
bio: Harry Bennett returned in June 1886 after recovering eight of Johnny Goodall's horses about sixty miles west of Fort McGinness, and brought back a story of lariat skill. In October 1886 he started out with Ferris & Merrifield's cattle, planning to winter at his home in Ohio.
